figurative_meaning_en: skeleton (extremely thin person, reduced to bones)
example_sentences_in_bangla: খাবার না খেয়ে সে কাঠের মতো হয়ে পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has become skin and bones due to famine.
Without eating, she has turned into a skeleton.
note: Refers to extreme thinness, often linked to hardship or illness in Bengali colloquial usage.
